evidence.source_assertion: Trimethylhistidine (TMH/hercynine) increased apparent KM without changing kcat in purified EgtD assays, consistent with competition against histidine and SAM. This is an in vitro product-inhibition result, not measured intracellular regulation.
evidence.source_locator: Supplement PDF p3, Figure S2 caption and kinetic plots; p1 Figure S1 assay conditions

removed_edge.description: Product inhibition is scoped to the purified M. smegmatis EgtD preparation; the assay contains MnII for the coupled system, not proof that EgtD itself requires manganese.

context_location: record description and preserved reference; no misplaced inhibition-only edge evidence
disposition: Remove unsupported exact-protein transfer, retain observed product inhibition as explicitly non-transferred preparation context; no claim the biology is refuted.
